headline: China Imported One Thousand Tons of Gold in Eight Months
summary: China accelerated its gold purchases over eight months amid growing geopolitical tensions and weak domestic investment options. The total is about one thousand tons.
why: Central bank and state-linked gold buying shapes global gold demand and prices, which investors track as a store of value.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Sustained large-scale buying increases demand for gold.
